journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu does not close when focus leaves the menu tree, causing the dropdown to remain visible and cover page content after tabbing out.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener to the menu element that checks if the related target is outside the menu; if so, and the menu has an open controller, close the controller.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a user tabs out of the navigation dropdown, the dropdown will close, preventing it from obscuring page content.
functional_risks: Potential unintended closure if focus moves to an element that is not a DOM descendant of the menu but is logically part of the menu (e.g., a portal).
If the menu is used as a trigger for non‑menu popups, those popups may close prematurely.
Edge cases where rapid focus shifts could cause flicker, though the containment check mitigates this.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from any menu item to an element outside the menu closes the dropdown (aria-expanded false, submenu hidden).
Moving focus within the menu or into a submenu does not close the dropdown.
Keyboard navigation inside the dropdown (arrow keys, Home, End) continues to work when open.
Clicking the Shop button still opens and closes the dropdown as expected.

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu does not close when focus leaves the menu tree via keyboard (Tab), because the root menu lacks a focusout handler to close open submenus when focus moves to an element outside the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout event listener to the root menu's DOM element that checks if focus has left the menu tree; if so, close all child submenus, reset focus state, and clear the hasOpened flag.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a keyboard user tabs out of the navigation dropdown, the dropdown will close (aria-expanded becomes false, submenu hidden), preventing it from obscuring page content.
functional_risks: Potential unintended closure if focus moves to an element that is not a DOM descendant of the menu but is logically part of the menu (e.g., a portal).
Edge cases where rapid focus shifts could cause flicker, though the containment check mitigates this.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from any menu item to an element outside the menu closes the dropdown (aria-expanded false, submenu hidden).
Moving focus within the menu or into a submenu does not close the dropdown.
Keyboard navigation inside the dropdown (arrow keys, Home, End) continues to work when open.
Clicking the Shop button still opens and closes the dropdown as expected.
